text: The on-board equipment shall use the last passed LRBG compliant balise group as the reference when reporting the train position to the RBC, where LRBG compliance depends on whether the balise group is marked as linked or unlinked and on whether linking consistency is checked on-board, as defined in SUBSET-026 §3.6.2.2.2 a).
reference_preconditions: Starting conditions: ERTMS/ETCS Mode FS / OS / SR / TR / PT / NL / LS / RV / AD / SM; ERTMS/ETCS Level L2; Radio communication session ESTABLISHED; Linking STORED: BG1 is contained in the linking information, Q_LINKREACTION=10; BG3 is not contained in the linking information; BG4 (not used in TC) beyond position of BG3 is contained in the linking information, Q_LINKREACTION=10; Position Report parameters STORED: Position reports issued periodically in space or in time. Interfaces: SAFE CONNECTION SET-UP (RTM). Constraints: Linking information stored on-board contains BG1 (step 1) and BG4 (not used in this TC) and does not contain BG3 (step 9).

reference_checks.action: The train passes BG1, a balise group marked as linked and contained in the stored linking information; the next position report is sent.
reference_checks.expected: The OBU reports its position to the RBC with BG1 as the LRBG (reference balise group).

reference_checks.action: After BG1, the train passes BG2, a balise group marked as unlinked; the next periodic position report is sent.
reference_checks.expected: The OBU still reports BG1 as the LRBG; the unlinked BG2 is not used as reference in the position report.

reference_checks.action: The train then passes BG3, a balise group marked as linked but not contained in the stored linking information (linking consistency is checked); the next periodic position report is sent.
reference_checks.expected: The OBU still reports BG1 as the LRBG; BG3 is not used as reference in the position report.

support_passages.text: 3.6.2.2.2 For the LRBG the following requirements have to be met: a) The on-board equipment shall use as a reference for reporting the train position to the RBC the last passed LRBG compliant balise group that fulfils the conditions of the clause 3.6.5.1.8. This balise group is termed as LRBGONB in the following. Only • balise groups marked as linked and contained in the previously received linking information, if linking consistency is checked on-board or • balise groups not marked as unlinked, if linking consistency was not checked when such a balise group was passed shall be regarded as LRBG compliant balise groups.

7.5.1.114 Q_LINK Name Link Qualifier Description This qualifier is used to mark a balise group as linked or unlinked. Length of variable Minimum Value Maximum Value Resolution/formula 1 bit Special/Reserved Values 0 Unlinked 1 Linked

method_rationale: Madde SUBSET-076-7 Tablo 3'te (test edilemez gereksinimler) yok ve SUBSET-076-5-2'de test vakası var: Test.
note: Tek test vakası (TC2); TC3 (linking STORED değil) çelişen ön koşul taşıdığı için birleştirilmedi. Beklenen sonuçlar arayüz düzeyinde: NID_MESSAGE_JRU değerleri SUBSET-027'den (JRU) gelir, derlemde yok; destek parçalarından yazılamaz. pdftotext alt simgeleri düzleştirdi: LRBGONB = LRBG_ONB. TC adım 9 BG3'ü (linking'de olmayan, Q_LINK=1) 'Referring to BG1' ile bitirir; linking tepkisi TC'de yok.

text: When receiving information from any transmission medium, the on-board equipment shall take into account only information valid for the train orientation and shall ignore other information, subject to the exceptions in SUBSET-026 §3.6.3.1.3.
reference_preconditions: Starting conditions: ERTMS/ETCS Mode OS / LS; ERTMS/ETCS Level L2; Radio communication session ESTABLISHED; Train Position STORED: Train running direction in relation to the direction of the LRBG : Reverse (0) or nominal (1), Q_DIRTRAIN=0 or 1. Interfaces: SAFE CONNECTION SET-UP (RTM). Constraints: The train is running and the train orientation in relation to the direction of the LRBG is known. Q_DIR variable of radio messages at step 1 and step 4 shall be set according to the orientation of the train in relation to the direction of the LRBG.

reference_checks.action: The OBU receives information by radio whose validity direction is opposite to the train orientation relative to the LRBG.
reference_checks.expected: The OBU ignores the information: none of the reactions it would call for occurs.

reference_checks.action: The OBU receives information by radio whose validity direction is the same as the train orientation relative to the LRBG.
reference_checks.expected: The OBU takes the information into account: the reaction it calls for occurs.

reference_checks.action: The OBU receives information by radio marked as valid for both directions.
reference_checks.expected: The OBU takes the information into account: the reaction it calls for occurs.

support_passages.text: 3.6.3.1.1 The direction for which transmitted information is valid shall refer to: a) the LRBG orientation for information sent by radio b) the balise group orientation for information sent by this balise group c) the loop orientation (which refers itself to the orientation of the balise group transmitting the EOLM information, see 3.4.5.1.3) for information sent by this loop 3.6.3.1.2 Data transmitted to the on-board equipment shall be identified as being valid for a) both directions b) the nominal direction c) the reverse direction of the referenced balise group (for information sent by balise or radio) or of the loop (for information sent by loop). 3.6.3.1.2.1 Deleted. 3.6.3.1.3 When receiving information from any transmission medium, the ERTMS/ETCS on-board equipment shall only take into account information valid for the train orientation. Other information shall be ignored. 3.6.3.1.3.1 Exception 1: for SL, PS and SH engines, balise group crossing direction shall be considered. 3.6.3.1.3.2 Exception 2: information in a Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation shall be taken into account also when its validity direction is opposite to that of the current train orientation

7.5.1.103 Q_DIR Name Validity direction of transmitted data Description Qualifier to indicate the relevant validity direction of transmitted data, with reference to directionality of the balise group sending the information or to directionality of the LRBG, in case of information sent via radio. Length of variable Minimum Value Maximum Value Resolution/formula 2 bits Special/Reserved Values 00 Reverse 01 Nominal 10 Both directions 11 Spare

method_rationale: Madde SUBSET-076-7 Tablo 3'te yok; SUBSET-076-5-2'de test vakası var: Test.
note: TC6 seçildi (3 I satırı, telsiz yolu); TC2 tek I satırlı, TC3 adım 6 §3.16.2.3.1.1'e ve reddedilen paket 5'e dayanıyor. Mesaj adları (15 Conditional Emergency Stop, 34 Track Ahead Free Request) ve DMI/JRU değerleri (ST01, Bit82, Bit38) destek parçalarında yok: SUBSET-026-8 mesaj listesi ve SUBSET-027/ERA DMI belgesi gerekir.

text: Whenever linking information is received, including when it is released from the transition buffer, the on-board equipment shall apply the replacement of stored linking information before determining the Single On-board Location Reference (SOLR), as specified in SUBSET-026 §3.6.4.2.2.2.
reference_preconditions: Starting conditions: ERTMS/ETCS Level L1; ERTMS/ETCS Mode FS / OS / LS / AD; Linking STORED: Linking information about BGx is stored on boad; Radio communication session STORED; Level Transition Order STORED: A level 2 transition order is stored on board. Constraints: -

reference_checks.action: The train passes the level 2 transition location; the buffered radio linking information, referenced to the earlier balise group FRBG and not announcing BGx, is released from the transition buffer.
reference_checks.expected: The OBU takes FRBG (the reference balise group of the released linking information) as the new SOLR instead of BGx.

support_passages.text: 3.6.4.2.2 The Single On-board Location Reference (SOLR) shall be: a) the last received balise group that is the reference of linking information or that is announced in linking information (including if it is announced with a balise group with ID “unknown” and it contains repositioning information), while the linking consistency is checked (see 3.4.4.2.1.1), or b) the last received balise group, while no linking consistency is checked. 3.6.4.2.2.1 Exception to 3.6.4.2.2 b): when exiting No Power mode, the SOLR shall be set to the stored LRBG if any. 3.6.4.2.2.2 Whenever linking information is received (e.g. when it is released from the transition buffer), the clause 3.7.3.1 m) shall be applied before this clause 3.6.4.2.2. For all other information, any relocation to the SOLR resulting from this clause 3.6.4.2.2 shall take place before the corresponding item of the clause 3.7.3.1 is applied. 3.6.4.2.2.3 Note: the SOLR is generally equal to the LRBGONB. For some cases however, like the transition to level 1/2 area, it might be possible that the linking information released from the transition buffer provokes the change of SOLR to a former LRBG in case this information does not announce every balise group in rear of the border (see Figure 13e).
m) New linking information received as non-infill information shall replace all stored linking information from the reference balise group of the new linking information.

method_rationale: Madde SUBSET-076-7 Tablo 3'te yok; SUBSET-076-5-2'de test vakası var: Test.
note: Adım 6'daki konum TC'de belirtilmemiş (seviye geçiş konumu olduğu çıkarılabilir, eklenmedi). Ön koşullardaki 'boad', 'refered', 'trasition' yazım hataları TC'den aynen alındı. NID_SOLR bir JRU değişkeni (SUBSET-027), derlemde yok. Geçiş tamponu kavramı SUBSET-026 §4.8'de; destek parçasına alınmadı.

text: The on-board equipment shall replace stored Static Speed Profile information with newly received Static Speed Profile information from the start location of the new information, as specified in SUBSET-026 §3.7.3.1 a).
reference_basis: SUBSET-076-5-2 v4.0.0 (SV30) Feature 3070300 TC14 (Based on: 3.7.3.1, 3.7.3.1 a)); steps 1→2, 3/5 (L1/L2 alternatives)→4, 6, 7-8
reference_preconditions: Starting conditions: ERTMS/ETCS Mode FS / OS / LS / AD / SM; ERTMS/ETCS Level L1 / L2; Radio communication session ESTABLISHED (Only in L2); Movement Authority STORED; International SSP STORED: Ends beyond the start location of SSP received from BGa or RBC. Interfaces: SAFE CONNECTION SET-UP (RTM) Only in L2; The speed and distance monitoring information is displayed (DMI): Speed and distance information is DISPLAYED, which reflects the currently stored SSP. Constraints: An SSP is stored on-board which ends beyond the start location of SSP received from BGa or RBC.

reference_checks.action: A new SSP that differs from the stored one and starts at a location the train has already reached (valid immediately), while the stored SSP extends beyond that start location, is received from a balise group (level 1) or the RBC (level 2).
reference_checks.expected: The OBU replaces the stored SSP from the start location of the new SSP and supervises speed according to the new SSP.

support_passages.text: 3.7.3.1 New track description and linking information shall replace (in the ERTMS/ETCS on-board equipment) stored information as detailed below: a) New Static Speed Profile information shall replace all stored Static Speed Profile information from the start location of the new information.

method_rationale: Madde SUBSET-076-7 Tablo 3'te yok; SUBSET-076-5-2'de test vakası var: Test.
note: TC'de adım 3 (L1, balise) ve 5 (L2, telsiz) seçenekli I satırları; tek eyleme birleştirildi, adım 4 ve 6 kendi koşuluyla, 7-8 her iki yol için beklenen sonuçta. Paket 27 = International Static Speed Profile (SUBSET-026-7 §7.4.1.1) destek parçasında yok. needs_documents: paket numarası ve JRU değerleri.

text: The on-board equipment shall send an MA request to the RBC when the triggering criterion defined by the RBC is reached and, together with any MA request, shall inform the RBC about the reason(s) applicable at the time the MA request is sent, as specified in SUBSET-026 §3.8.2.2.2 and §3.8.2.1.7.
reference_preconditions: Starting conditions: ERTMS/ETCS Mode FS / OS / LS / AD; ERTMS/ETCS Level L2; Radio communication session ESTABLISHED; Movement Authority STORED; Gradient Profile STORED; International SSP STORED; MA Request Parameters STORED: T_TIMEOUTRQST=1023, T_CYCRQST=10, No MA request triggering with regards to this function; Train Position V_TRAIN > 0. Interfaces: SAFE CONNECTION SET-UP (RTM). Constraints: There are an initial MA and a complete track description on-board. The MA request is sent with Q_MARQSTREASON = xxx1x (Time before reaching the perturbation location reached).

reference_checks.action: With a time before reaching the perturbation location defined by the RBC, the train's max safe front end reaches the location from which it would reach the perturbation location within that time at warning speed.
reference_checks.expected: The OBU sends an MA request to the RBC.

reference_checks.action: The MA request triggered by passing the perturbation-location criterion is sent.
reference_checks.expected: The OBU informs the RBC with the request that the reason is 'time before reaching the perturbation location reached'.

support_passages.text: 3.8.2.1.5 As long as at least one reason for sending MA requests is applicable and unless it is requested by the RBC not to do so, the ERTMS/ETCS on-board equipment shall repeat the MA requests as indicated by the RBC or with a repetition cycle according to a fixed value (see appendix A.3.1) in case no MA request parameters are stored on-board.
3.8.2.1.7 Together with any MA request the on-board shall inform the RBC about the reason(s) that is (are) applicable at the time the MA request is sent.

3.8.2.2.1 The triggering criteria that can be used by the RBC are the following: a) A defined time before the train reaches the perturbation location assuming it is running at the warning speed (see section 3.13.11 for details). b) A defined time before the Section timer (not the End Section timer, not the Overlap timer) for any section of the MA expires, or before the LOA speed timer expires. 3.8.2.2.2 With regard to the above possibilities, the MA request shall be triggered when the train front has passed the location defined by 3.8.2.2.1 a) / when the moment defined by 3.8.2.2.1 b) is reached.

7.5.1.118.3 Q_MARQSTREASON Name Reason for MA request sending Description Qualifier to indicate the reason why the MA request is sent to the RBC Length of variable Minimum Value Maximum Value Resolution/formula 5 bits Bitset Special/Reserved Values xxxx1 Start selected by driver xxx1x Time before reaching the perturbation location reached xx1xx Time before a section timer/LOA speed timer expires reached x1xxx Track description deleted 1xxxx TAF up to level 2 transition location

method_rationale: Madde SUBSET-076-7 Tablo 3'te yok; SUBSET-076-5-2'de test vakası var: Test.
note: TC7 §3.8.2.1.7 ve §3.8.2.2.2'ye dayanıyor; gereksinim metni ikisini kapsar. Adımlar tekrar davranışını (§3.8.2.1.5, T_CYCRQST) da sınar ve bu madde TC'nin dayanak listesinde yok: 2. ve 4. denetim cümleden tek başına çıkmaz (destek parçası P1 bunun için). TC1 (§3.8.2.1.4, §3.8.2.1.7, §3.8.2.2.2) iç tutarsızlıklar (T_MAR 1023/255, T_TIMEOUTREQUEST) nedeniyle seçilmedi. 3. denetim (duruşta konum raporu) gereksinimle ilgisiz bir ara adım; TC'de olduğu için tutuldu.

text: The portal shall enforce the minimum password lengths for passwords used as a single-factor and as part of a multi-factor authentication mechanism, evaluate password length and verify submitted passwords as specified in NIST SP 800-63B-4 §3.1.1.2.
reference_basis: NIST SP 800-63-4 conformance criteria v0.1 (OSCAL, 30 Sep 2026): PV-1 (TEST), PV-2 (TEST), PV-7 (EXAMINE, TEST)

reference_checks.action: PV-1 TEST: Try to create a password that does not meet the minimum length requirements.
reference_checks.expected: The password is not accepted.

reference_checks.action: PV-2 TEST: Create a password containing a Unicode character such as an accented vowel.
reference_checks.expected: The password is accepted.

reference_checks.action: PV-2 TEST: Attempt to authenticate with the unaccented version of the same character.
reference_checks.expected: The unaccented version does not allow successful authentication.

reference_checks.action: PV-7 EXAMINE: Examine verification code.
reference_checks.expected: The entire password is verified.

reference_checks.action: PV-7 TEST: Create long passwords and attempt to authenticate with truncated passwords.
reference_checks.expected: Verifiers SHALL verify the entire submitted password (e.g., not truncate it).

support_passages.text: 3.1.1.2. Password Verifiers The following requirements apply to passwords. 1. Verifiers and CSPs SHALL require passwords that are used as a single-factor authentication mechanism to be a minimum of 15 characters in length. Verifiers and CSPs MAY allow passwords that are only used as part of multi-factor authentication processes to be shorter but SHALL require them to be a minimum of eight characters in length. 2. Verifiers and CSPs SHOULD permit a maximum password length of at least 64 characters. 3. Verifiers and CSPs SHOULD accept all printing ASCII [RFC20] characters and the space character in passwords. 4. Verifiers and CSPs SHOULD accept Unicode [ISO/ISC 10646] characters in passwords. Each Unicode code point SHALL be counted as a single character when evaluating password length.
9. Verifiers SHALL request the password to be provided in full (not a subset of it) and SHALL verify the entire submitted password (e.g., not truncate it).

method_rationale: Uygunluk kriteri yöntemleri: TEST → Test; EXAMINE (doğrulama kodunun incelenmesi) → İnceleme.
note: PV-1 testi eşik vermiyor (15/8 karakter belgede); PV-7 TEST için beklenen sonuç kriter metninde yok, ifade PV-7 statement'tan aynen alındı. PV-2'nin 'accepted' ve 'unaccented ... does not allow' kısımları iki denetime bölündü. Parola kara listesi (PV-8..PV-11) kapsam dışında tutuldu.

text: The portal shall limit consecutive failed authentication attempts on a subscriber account and handle authenticators disabled by this rate limiting as specified in NIST SP 800-63B-4 §3.2.2.
reference_basis: NIST SP 800-63-4 conformance criteria v0.1: PV-12 (TEST), RL-2 (TEST, EXAMINE), RL-3 (TEST, EXAMINE), RL-4 (TEST)

reference_checks.action: PV-12 TEST: Make a large number of incorrect authentication attempts.
reference_checks.expected: The number and/or rate of attempts is limited.

reference_checks.action: RL-2 TEST + EXAMINE: Make 101 authentication failures with an authenticator; examine the subscriber account.
reference_checks.expected: The authenticator has been disabled.

reference_checks.action: RL-3 TEST + EXAMINE: Make excessive authentication failures with two authenticators; examine the subscriber account.
reference_checks.expected: Both authenticators have been disabled.

reference_checks.action: RL-4 TEST: Cause an authenticator to be disabled due to excessive authentication failures.
reference_checks.expected: There is no way to successfully use the authenticator other than to go through the authenticator binding procedure.

support_passages.text: 3.2.2. Rate Limiting (Throttling) When required by the authenticator type descriptions in Sec. 3.1, the verifier SHALL implement controls to protect against online guessing attacks. Unless otherwise specified in the description of a given authenticator, the verifier SHALL limit consecutive failed authentication attempts using a specific authenticator on a single subscriber account to no more than 100 by disabling that authenticator. If more than one authenticator is involved with an excessive number of authentication attempts (e.g., single-factor cryptographic authenticator and centrally verified password), both authenticators SHALL be disabled. Authenticators that have been disabled SHALL be required to rebind to the subscriber account, as described in Sec. 4.1, to be usable in the future.
Verifiers SHALL implement a rate-limiting mechanism that effectively limits the number of failed authentication attempts that can be made on the subscriber account, as described in Sec. 3.2.2.

method_rationale: TEST → Test; EXAMINE (abone hesabının incelenmesi) → İnceleme.
note: RL-2 ve RL-3'te TEST ile EXAMINE aynı denetime gruplandı (eylem + gözlem). RL-2..RL-4 kriterleri AAL2/AAL3 işaretli, PV-12 ALL; portalın AAL'si proje belgelerinden gelmeli. '101' sınırı kriterde açık, gereksinim cümlesinde yok. Yeniden kimlik doğrulama (REAUTH-*) yerine bu küme seçildi: REAUTH-1, -3, -4, -5 yalnız EXAMINE, REAUTH-2 SB-8.4'e yönlendiriyor; TEST yok.

text: Every page of the portal shall declare its default human language so that it can be programmatically determined, in conformance with WCAG 2.2 Success Criterion 3.1.1 Language of Page (Level A).
reference_basis: W3C ACT rule b5c3f8 'HTML page has lang attribute' (approved, latest version 31 August 2023) and ACT rule bf051a 'HTML page lang attribute has valid language tag' (approved version 28 January 2022; the newer proposed version of 21 June 2022 not used): Applicability + Expectation

reference_checks.action: b5c3f8 Applicability: for any document element that is an html element in a top-level browsing context and has a node document with a content type of text/html, inspect its lang attribute.
reference_checks.expected: b5c3f8 Expectation: Each test target has a lang attribute value that is neither empty ("") nor only ASCII whitespace.

reference_checks.action: bf051a Applicability: for any document element that is an html element which has a lang attribute that is neither empty nor only ASCII whitespace, is in a top-level browsing context and has a node document with a content type of text/html, inspect its lang attribute.
reference_checks.expected: bf051a Expectation: For each test target, the lang attribute has a known primary language tag.

support_passages.doc: W3C WCAG 2.2 (via WAI ACT rules index)
support_passages.text: 3.1.1 Language of Page: The default human language of each web page can be programmatically determined.
Known Primary Language Tag A language tag has a known primary language tag if its primary language subtag exists in the language subtag registry with a Type field whose field-body value is language.

method_rationale: ACT kuralı uygulanmış sayfa üzerinde (otomatik ya da elle) yürütülen bir test prosedürü: Test.
note: Her ACT kuralı tek Applicability+Expectation verir; 2 denetime ulaşmak için SC 3.1.1'e eşlenen iki onaylı kural birleştirildi ('inspect its lang attribute' bağlayıcı ifadesi eklendi). Kuralın geçmesi SC'yi sağlamaz, yalnızca 'daha fazla test gerekir'; başarısızlık SC ihlalidir. P2 sözlük tanımı kural sayfasından (normatif WCAG değil); ilk denetim H57 bilgisiyle belgesiz de yazılabilir.

text: Portal, kullanıcı oturumlarını Bilgi ve İletişim Güvenliği Rehberi (v1.1) 3.2.2.3 "Kullanıcı Oturumlarının Sonlandırılması" tedbirinde tanımlandığı şekilde sonlandırmalıdır.

source.doc: Bilgi ve İletişim Güvenliği Rehberi v1.1 (Siber Güvenlik Başkanlığı)

reference_basis: SGB Rehber v1.1, 3.2.2 Oturum Yönetimi, Denetim Maddeleri, tedbir 3.2.2.3 (Denetim Yöntem Önerileri: Mülakat, Gözden Geçirme, Sızma Testi; 5 denetim sorusu)

reference_checks.action: Kullanıcı oturumu kapattığında oturumun sonlandığının test edilip edilmediğini denetle.
reference_checks.expected: Kullanıcı oturumu kapattığında oturumun sonlandığı test edilmiştir.

reference_checks.action: İşlem yapılmadan beklenecek sürenin ve/veya oturum kimliğinin geçerlilik süresinin yetkisiz güncellenip güncellenemediğini denetle.
reference_checks.expected: İşlem yapılmadan beklenecek süre ve/veya oturum kimliğinin geçerlilik süresi yetkisiz güncellenemez.

reference_checks.action: Oluşturulan oturum kimliğinin geçerlilik süresinin belirlenip belirlenmediğini denetle.
reference_checks.expected: Oluşturulan oturum kimliğinin geçerlilik süresi belirlenmiştir.

reference_checks.action: İşlem yapılmadan beklenen geçerlilik süresi sonunda oturumun durumunu denetle.
reference_checks.expected: Oturum sonlandırılır.

reference_checks.action: Kullanıcının, oturumun geçersiz olmasına sebep olacak bilgilerini değiştirdikten sonra etkin olan tüm oturumlarını sonlandırıp sonlandıramadığını denetle.
reference_checks.expected: Kullanıcı etkin olan tüm oturumlarını sonlandırabilir.

reference_checks.action: Oturum sonlandığında oturum ile ilgili geçici depolama alanlarını ve çerezleri denetle.
reference_checks.expected: Oturum ile ilgili tüm geçici depolama alanları ve çerezler uygulama tarafından silinir.

support_passages.doc: Bilgi ve İletişim Güvenliği Rehberi v1.1
support_passages.text: Kimlik doğrulamayla erişilen tüm sayfalardan oturum kapatma işlevine erişilebilmelidir. Buna ek olarak, oluşturulan oturum kimliğinin geçerlilik süresi belirlenmelidir. İlgili süre sonunda, belirli süre etkinlik olmadığında veya kullanıcı oturumu kapattığında oturum geçersiz hale gelmelidir. İlgili sürelerin güncellenmesi sürecinde yetkilendirme mekanizmasından faydalanılmalıdır. Ayrıca oturumun geçersiz olmasına sebep olacak bilgilerin değişmesi durumunda (kullanıcı parolasının güncellenmesi, yetkilerin güncellenmesi vb.) etkin oturumların sonlandırılması sağlanmalıdır. Oturum sonlandığında istemci ve sunucuda oturum ile ilgili tüm geçici depolama alanları ve çerezler uygulama tarafından silinmelidir.

method_rationale: Rehber tedbir 3.2.2.3 yöntemleri: Mülakat → İnceleme, Gözden Geçirme → İnceleme, Sızma Testi → Test. Yöntemler soru başına değil tedbir başına verilmiş.
note: Soru-tedbir eşleşmesi PDF'teki tablo çizgilerinin konumuyla doğrulandı (-layout çıktısında 'Hata mesajlarının...' sorusu 3.2.2.2'ye aittir). 3. soru iki soru içeriyor, iki denetime bölündü. 2. sorunun beklenen yanıtı ('yetkisiz güncellenemez') sorudan değil tedbir tanımından ('yetkilendirme mekanizmasından faydalanılmalıdır') çıkarıldı. 1. soru davranışı değil test kanıtını soruyor. Tedbir tanımındaki 'tüm sayfalardan oturum kapatma işlevine erişim' için denetim sorusu yok.

reference_basis: NIST SP 800-53A Rev. 5 assessment procedure AC-07, assessment objectives AC-07_ODP[01]-[06], AC-07a., AC-07b. (methods EXAMINE/INTERVIEW/TEST given only at control level)

reference_checks.action: Determine if the number of consecutive invalid logon attempts by a user allowed during a time period is defined (AC-07_ODP[01]).
reference_checks.expected: The number of consecutive invalid logon attempts by a user allowed during a time period is defined.

reference_checks.action: Determine if the time period to which the number of consecutive invalid logon attempts by a user is limited is defined (AC-07_ODP[02]).
reference_checks.expected: The time period to which the number of consecutive invalid logon attempts by a user is limited is defined.

reference_checks.action: Determine if one or more of the following parameter values is/are selected: {lock the account or node for <AC-07_ODP[04] time period>; lock the account or node until released by an administrator; delay next logon prompt per <AC-07_ODP[05] delay algorithm>; notify system administrator; take other <AC-07_ODP[06] action>} (AC-07_ODP[03]).
reference_checks.expected: One or more of the parameter values is/are selected.

reference_checks.action: Determine if the time period for an account or node to be locked, the delay algorithm for the next logon prompt and the other action to be taken when the maximum number of unsuccessful attempts is exceeded are defined, if selected (AC-07_ODP[04]-[06]).
reference_checks.expected: The time period for an account or node to be locked is defined (if selected); the delay algorithm for the next logon prompt is defined (if selected); the other action to be taken when the maximum number of unsuccessful attempts is exceeded is defined (if selected).

reference_checks.action: Determine if a limit of <AC-07_ODP[01] number> consecutive invalid logon attempts by a user during <AC-07_ODP[02] time period> is enforced (AC-07a.).
reference_checks.expected: A limit of <AC-07_ODP[01] number> consecutive invalid logon attempts by a user during <AC-07_ODP[02] time period> is enforced.

reference_checks.action: Determine if the system automatically <AC-07_ODP[03] SELECTED PARAMETER VALUES> when the maximum number of unsuccessful attempts is exceeded (AC-07b.).
reference_checks.expected: Automatically <AC-07_ODP[03] SELECTED PARAMETER VALUE(S)> when the maximum number of unsuccessful attempts is exceeded.

support_passages.text: AC-7 Unsuccessful Logon Attempts. Control: a. Enforce a limit of [Assignment: organization-defined number] consecutive invalid logon attempts by a user during a [Assignment: organization-defined time period]; and b. Automatically [Selection (one or more): lock the account or node for [Assignment: organization-defined time period]; lock the account or node until released by an administrator; delay next logon prompt per [Assignment: organization-defined delay algorithm]; notify system administrator; take other [Assignment: organization-defined action]] when the maximum number of unsuccessful attempts is exceeded.

method_rationale: 800-53A AC-07 yöntemleri kontrol düzeyinde: EXAMINE → İnceleme, INTERVIEW → İnceleme, TEST → Test. Hedef başına yöntem atanmadı.
note: 800-53A yalnızca değerlendirme hedeflerini verir; adım, girdi ya da beklenen sonuç yok. Eylem 'Determine if ...' hedefi, beklenen sonuç hedefin olumlu hâli; ODP[04]-[06] ('if selected') tek denetimde gruplandı. Gerçek parametre değerleri sistem güvenlik planındadır (sentetik belgeler henüz yok). Denetimler hedef metninden yazılabildiği için resmî referans iddiası zayıf: test edilebilir davranış yalnızca son iki denetimde.
